selection_method: Stratified random sample of 4,000 scenarios from the 21,605-scenario TRAIN split only. seed=42. Procedure: split train ids into FAIL/PASS pools, shuffle each independently (random.seed(42)), take the same FAIL fraction as the full train split (8294/21605=38.39%) from the front of each shuffled pool (1535 FAIL + 2465 PASS = 4000), then shuffle the combined sample. This preserves the train-split base rate and uses a fixed, pre-specified seed -- not selected after inspecting any result.
